def debug_solve(input_grid):
    rows = len(input_grid)
    cols = len(input_grid[0])
    
    non_bg_colors = {}
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = input_grid[r][c]
            if color != 4:
                non_bg_colors[(r, c)] = color
    
    colors = {}
    for (r, c), color in non_bg_colors.items():
        if color not in colors:
            colors[color] = []
        colors[color].append((r, c))
    
    print("non_bg_colors keys:", sorted(non_bg_colors.keys()))
    print("colors:", colors)
    
    output_grid = [row[:] for row in input_grid]
    
    for color, positions in colors.items():
        print(f"\nProcessing color {color}, positions: {positions}")
        for i in range(len(positions)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(positions)):
                (r1, c1) = positions[i]
                (r2, c2) = positions[j]
                
                if r2 > r1 and c2 > c1 and abs(r2 - r1) == abs(c2 - c1):
                    dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
                    steps_no = abs(dr)
                    print(f"  Drawing diagonal from ({r1}, {c1}) to ({r2}, {c2}) with dr={dr}, dc={dc}, steps={steps_no}")
                    
                    for k in range(1, steps_no + 1):

                        print(f"    k={k}: ({nr}, {nc}), between={is_between}, background={is_background}")
                        
                        if is_between and 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and is_background:
